BasePacks.Name: Base item sources
BasePacks.Label: Choose compendiums
BasePacks.Hint: Which compendiums the Magic Item Builder lists base items from, alongside PMI's built-in rings, amulets, cloaks, boots, gloves, belts, bracers, circlets, wands and rods. Only compendiums with usable mundane items are shown; the number is how many each has.
BasePacks.None: No compendiums with mundane weapons, armor, shields, wands, staves or rods were found.

SpellPacks.Name: Spell sources
SpellPacks.Label: Choose compendiums
SpellPacks.Hint: Which compendiums wand, staff and rod properties pick spells from. The number is how many spells each has. Items you've already created keep their spells.
SpellPacks.None: No compendiums with spells were found.

OpenBuilder.Name: Magic Item Builder
OpenBuilder.Label: Open Magic Item Builder
OpenBuilder.Hint: Opens the builder. The same as the button at the top of the Items sidebar.

PowerTier.Name: Strongest effects
PowerTier.Hint: Numbers that grow with rarity (ability scores, bonuses, healing and damage dice, ranges) stop growing at this rarity. Rarer items still get a bigger budget and more properties. Applies to new rolls; items you've created keep their numbers.

MaxAbilityScore.Name: Highest ability score
MaxAbilityScore.Hint: The highest score a property that sets an ability score (like a belt of giant strength) may give.

MaxBonus.Name: Highest flat bonus
MaxBonus.Hint: The highest +N a property may give to AC, saving throws, attack rolls, spell attacks and save DCs, including +1/+2/+3 enhancements. Stronger properties are left out of rolls and marked on existing drafts.

CurseChance.Name: Drawback chance (%)
CurseChance.Hint: How often a random roll adds a drawback, such as a lowered ability score or spines that bite the wielder. Each drawback gives budget back, so the item can carry more. The builder can always add one by hand.

Triggers.ChargesRestored: {name} drinks in the moment of death and regains {count} charge(s).
